_comment: XSOAR 6.2 classifier — assigns the 'TLCTC Threat' incident type to incoming alerts when an ATT&CK technique ID is present. Use with the mapper at attck-tlctc-mapper.json. Import via Settings → Object Setup → Classification & Mapping → New Classifier.
name: ATT&CK→TLCTC Classifier
description: Tags inbound alerts as 'TLCTC Threat' when an ATT&CK technique ID is detected; lets the mapper extract the technique into incident_tlctcattcktechniques and the preProcessingScript (TLCTCClassify) derive the cluster.
